name: Derived mID
title: Derived mID | Scytáles
description: NFC card authentication that derives credentials from security documents into mobile virtual IDs at Level of Assurance 3.

hero.headline: Go Cardless, Go Mobile: NFC-Based Authentication at Your Fingertips
hero.sub: The Scytáles Derived Mobile ID is an NFC card authentication app that derives credentials from security documents into mobile virtual IDs at Level of Assurance 3.
bullets: PIV / eIDAS NFC card signing toward web services
BYOD or shared-device deployment for organisations

showcase.statCopy: High-assurance NFC authentication derived from physical security documents

features.body: Read and electronically sign toward web services, and verify contactless derived data from physical smartcards, health cards, loyalty cards, and more, using a mobile device and NFC.
Each tap activates authentication and contacts an identity provider to access the System of Records remotely: the right person, right information, right time.
Deploy on personal devices (BYOD) or shared phones and tablets in organisational infrastructure such as healthcare facilities, for secure access without a desktop.

discover.copy: Certified ISO 18013-5 validation for wallets, mobile IDs, and mobile driving licences.
Carry official physical and digital credentials on your phone with EUDI-ready wallet support.
Trusted service establishing authenticity between issuers and mDL, mID, and wallet providers.

statement: Scytáles delivers Derived Mobile ID as part of a full mobile identity stack, from wallets and validators to service management. It is trusted by governments, healthcare, and enterprises that need high-assurance NFC authentication.
